subject: Reseller invoicing & tax-source for marketplace co-sell (BigRetailer)
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara@bigretailer.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reseller settlement and tax sourcing for CloudBridge listing

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this—quick background: BigRetailer will be the reseller in our AWS listing (CloudBridge listing) that resells Redwood-powered service to its customers. Payments route through the marketplace, but in several EU countries our reseller does 'self-bill' and they expect reseller-side invoicing lines for downstream clients. We need clarity on how Redwood will accept tax evidence and produce the settlement invoice CSV for our finance team.

Two specific asks:
- What exact tax docs do you need from the reseller vs. from the end-customer for US and EU scenarios (W-9/W-8, VAT certificates, VAT reverse-charge evidence)?
- Is there an option for Redwood to emit a single consolidated settlement invoice to BigRetailer that includes split tax sourcing info (so their AP team can allocate VAT correctly), or do we have to submit separate invoices per end-customer?

We may attach a sample AP format (CSV) if helpful. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks,
Sara
Head of Cloud Partnerships
BigRetailer Inc.
attachments: sample-ap-layout.csv (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara@bigretailer.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller settlement and tax sourcing for CloudBridge listing

Sara — thanks for the clear note. Looping in Karthik (sales ops) and Vanessa (channel/billing) who handle marketplace settlement flows. High level guidance up front, then I’ll call out the implementation options we support:

1) Tax documents we typically request
  - Reseller (BigRetailer): US entity -> W-9; Non-US entity -> W-8BEN-E (if they’re claiming treaty or non-US withholding).
  - EU: VAT registration certificate (VIES or local certificate) for the reseller if they are the taxable person. For reverse-charge scenarios, we need their VAT number and evidence of business use (contract/purchase order) to support zero-rating in some jurisdictions.
  - End-customer: If tax rules require evidence of business status for reverse-charge (EU), BigRetailer is expected to collect and keep that evidence; Redwood will accept copies if you want us to include it in our settlement artifacts.

2) Invoicing/split options we support (pick one):
  A) Consolidated settlement invoice to reseller: Redwood issues one settlement invoice per payout period to BigRetailer. That invoice includes line-level metadata: marketplace item id, end-customer id (hashed), list price, tax amount, and tax sourcing field ("tax_source=marketplace|reseller|customer"). This is the least operational overhead for BigRetailer and is compatible with self-billing if your AP wants a single invoice.
  B) Per-end-customer invoices: Redwood issues invoices per end-customer. Use this if local tax law requires direct invoicing to the end-customer by the service provider.

3) Withholding: If BigRetailer is a US entity purchasing on behalf of US customers, withholding typically does not apply. If they are a foreign reseller and withhold is required by local rules, we will need the W-8 documentation to apply the correct withholding rate and produce withholding statements for your AP.

4) Credit memos / adjustments: We can produce credit memos tied to the settlement invoice id. For marketplace self-bill flows, we recommend one consolidated credit memo per settlement period to simplify reconciliation.

Next steps: Karthik / Vanessa — can you confirm whether BigRetailer wants option A (consolidated) or B (per-customer), and whether they will provide W-9 and VAT certs? Sara, if you can upload W-9/W-8 and the VAT docs to the Drive folder linked below we’ll ingest and route to finance.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-redwood-marketplace-evidence

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
---
(This email references internal settlement model docs and our marketplace CSV schema; I can attach a template if helpful)
